title: TheWallDev Interop Tag Embedded in Charity Names
description: Schema describing the textual interop tag embedded inside a Charity layer name so that Charity exports can carry their original TheWallDev identity and backend URL. The backend parses and strips this tag during import (see backend/src/formats/charity.rs). Because the tag is a plain substring inside a free-form string, this schema documents the canonical format rather than validating an entire JSON document.

tag.description: Canonical interop tag format: '(TheWallDev: ID:<id>[;BACKEND:<url>])'. The id is an opaque string (usually a UUID). The optional BACKEND segment points at the originating backend instance. Whitespace is tolerated around the delimiters.

id.description: The recovered ID from the tag. May be any non-empty string without ';', ')' or whitespace.

backendUrl.description: The recovered BACKEND URL, if present.
